# civicDebateBoard — Business Model and Analytics

Business requirements only; all technical implementation decisions (architecture, APIs, data pipelines, analytics tooling, storage, dashboards) remain at the discretion of the development team. Describes WHAT outcomes must be achieved in business terms, not HOW to implement them.

## 1) Why This Service Exists (recap)

civicDebateBoard improves the quality, transparency, and civility of online civic discourse. Structured discussions, fact-checking roles, and policy-aligned moderation workflows enable responsible debate on complex topics.

Differentiators
- Role design that includes verifiedMember and factChecker to elevate credibility and timely corrections.
- Measurable safety and transparency requirements that prioritize community health over raw engagement.
- Governance for data use and analytics that protects privacy and democratic processes.

Alignment with related documents
- Strategic vision and scope: [Service Vision and Overview](./01-service-vision-and-overview.md).
- Capabilities and constraints for user actions: [Functional Requirements](./06-functional-requirements.md).
- Performance and availability expectations: [Non-Functional Requirements and SLAs](./08-non-functional-requirements-and-slas.md).

## 2) Revenue Strategy Options and Guardrails

Sustainable monetization must never compromise civic integrity or user trust. Approaches may be combined under strict guardrails.

### 2.1 Advertising (Contextual, Non-Microtargeted)
- Contextual placements adjacent to topics; never embedded within arguments to avoid misattribution.
- No behavioral microtargeting based on sensitive attributes or political beliefs.
- Frequency caps and clear, persistent disclosures for paid placements.

EARS Requirements — Advertising
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL label paid placements with an unambiguous disclosure visible wherever the placement appears.
- WHERE advertising is enabled, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL apply a per-user daily impression cap of 3 impressions per unique campaign.
- WHERE advertising is enabled, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prohibit targeting based on sensitive attributes including political affiliation, religion, health status, or inferred beliefs.
- IF a paid placement conflicts with safety policies (misinformation, hate speech, election manipulation), THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL reject the placement and provide a categorical reason to the advertiser.
- WHEN a user opts out of personalized ads, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL restrict ad selection to contextual signals and record the consent state for compliance reporting.
- WHILE a political event moratorium (election blackout) is active, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL disable new political ad activations and freeze existing political campaigns.
- WHERE an ad appears near user-generated content, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL ensure adjacency rules avoid implying endorsement by the adjacent author.

### 2.2 Sponsorships (Topic, Series, or Event-Based)
- Brand sponsorship of topic hubs, expert AMAs, or fact-checking series with guardrails to prevent editorial interference.
- Sponsors may fund public-interest fact-checking efforts without control over outcomes.

EARS Requirements — Sponsorships
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL disclose sponsor identity on all sponsored surfaces associated with the sponsor.
- WHERE a content area is sponsored, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prevent sponsor accounts from editing or removing user content or fact-check annotations.
- IF a sponsor attempts to influence moderation or fact-check outcomes, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL document the attempt and escalate to policy governance for review.
- WHEN a sponsored AMA is scheduled, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL present sponsorship disclosure on the announcement and session surfaces throughout the campaign.
- WHERE a sponsor has a direct stake in a topic (e.g., active lobbying), THE civicDebateBoard SHALL display a conflict-of-interest label on sponsored surfaces for that topic.

### 2.3 Subscriptions (Member-Supported)
- Optional subscriptions for power users and institutions: reduced ads, advanced topic insights, and support for fact-checking capacity.
- No paywalling of core civic participation (reading, posting, voting) to preserve accessibility.

EARS Requirements — Subscriptions
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL keep core participation features (reading, posting, voting, reporting) accessible without payment.
- WHERE subscriptions are active, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL present a clear list of benefits before purchase and on the account page thereafter.
- IF payment fails or a subscription lapses, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL revert benefits within 24 hours and retain access to core participation features.
- WHEN a user cancels a subscription, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL stop future billing immediately and retain benefits until the end of the current paid period.
- WHERE institutional subscriptions are active, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL allow assignment and revocation of seats without affecting user data ownership or posting history.
- WHERE subscription benefits include reduced ad load, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL cap ad frequency at 0–1 per day per user under the plan.

### 2.4 Grants and Public-Interest Funding
- Eligibility for grants from foundations and civic institutions to support fact-checking, moderation research, or community education.

EARS Requirements — Grants
- WHEN grant funding is received for a public-interest initiative, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL separate editorial decision-making from grant reporting structures.
- WHERE a grant imposes transparency obligations, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL publish required acknowledgments on relevant program pages.

### 2.5 General Monetization Guardrails
- No sale or licensing of personal data; revenue must not depend on data brokerage.
- Monetization experiments must pass policy, privacy, and ethics review before launch.
- No pay-for-reach or pay-to-amplify mechanics in civic discourse.

EARS Requirements — Monetization Guardrails
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL refrain from selling or licensing personal data to third parties for unrelated purposes.
- WHEN launching a monetization experiment, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL require prior governance approval with documented objectives, metrics, and guardrails.
- IF revenue objectives conflict with safety or integrity metrics, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prioritize safety and integrity and pause the conflicting initiative.
- WHERE revenue content intersects with political topics, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL apply election-period restrictions and conflict-of-interest disclosures.

## 3) User Acquisition and Growth Strategy

Growth emphasizes trust, transparency, and utility over vanity metrics.

Tactics
- Partnerships with civic organizations, universities, and local newsrooms to onboard verifiedMember contributors and host educational threads.
- Invitation flows and topic follows that return participants to relevant debates without spam or dark patterns.
- Recognition for high-quality contributions over quantity (e.g., helpfulness signals, accepted corrections).

EARS Requirements — Growth
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prohibit dark patterns (confusing consent, disguised ads, forced continuity) in acquisition or retention flows.
- WHEN a user invites a contact, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL send a single, clearly labeled invitation and SHALL not re-message the contact without explicit consent.
- WHERE growth notifications are enabled, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL limit notification sends to a maximum of 2 per user per day and SHALL include a one-click opt-out per category.
- IF a partner’s onboarding content violates safety policies, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL remove the content and notify the partner with policy references.
- WHEN a verifiedMember application is approved per policy criteria, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL elevate the account and adjust rate limits within 1 hour.
- WHERE referral programs operate, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL cap referral benefits to prevent spam incentives and SHALL revoke benefits for abuse.

Funnel Metrics (targets; monitor monthly)
- Visitor-to-registration conversion: ≥ 15% (Amber: 10–14%; Red: < 10%).
- Registration-to-activation (first post or comment within 7 days): ≥ 60% (Amber: 45–59%; Red: < 45%).
- Activation-to-30d retention: ≥ 20% (Amber: 15–19%; Red: < 15%).

## 4) Analytics KPIs and Reporting Cadence

KPI definitions measure growth, engagement, quality, safety, and revenue while honoring privacy and consent. Metrics are aggregated with data minimization; sensitive data is excluded or aggregated as required.

EARS Requirements — Analytics and Reporting
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL maintain a weekly operational report covering growth, engagement, quality, safety, and monetization KPIs with owner accountability.
- WHEN a KPI crosses an alert threshold, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL create an incident entry in the business review log within 24 hours and assign a responsible owner.
- WHERE consent is required for analytics, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL exclude non-consenting users from analytics cohorts and annotate reports accordingly.
- IF a metric requires sensitive data to compute, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL use a privacy-preserving aggregate or omit the metric and document the omission.
- WHERE a KPI definition changes, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL version the definition and annotate trend breaks in the next report.

KPI Catalog and Targets (formulas and targets)

| KPI | Business Definition | Formula (business-level) | Target (Green) | Alert Threshold (Amber/Red) | Required Breakdowns | Owner | Cadence |
|-----|---------------------|---------------------------|----------------|------------------------------|---------------------|-------|---------|
| Monthly Active Users (MAU) | Unique authenticated users active in a calendar month | Count of unique users with ≥1 session | ≥ 100,000 | Amber: < 80,000; Red: < 60,000 | Role, region, acquisition source | Growth Lead | Monthly |
| Daily Active Users (DAU) | Unique authenticated users active on a given day | Count of unique users with ≥1 session | DAU/MAU ≥ 40% | Amber: 30–39%; Red: < 30% | Role, topic category | Growth Lead | Daily |
| New Registrations | Accounts created | Count of new accounts | ≥ 15,000/mo | Amber: < 10,000; Red: < 7,000 | Source, region | Growth Lead | Weekly |
| Activation Rate | New users who complete first post or comment within 7 days | Activated users / new registrations | ≥ 60% | Amber: 45–59%; Red: < 45% | Role, source | Product Lead | Weekly |
| 7-Day Retention | New users active 7 days after registration | Returners day 7 / new registrations | ≥ 35% | Amber: 25–34%; Red: < 25% | Role, source | Product Analytics | Weekly |
| 30-Day Retention | New users active 30 days after registration | Returners day 30 / new registrations | ≥ 20% | Amber: 15–19%; Red: < 15% | Role, source | Product Analytics | Monthly |
| Posts per Active Member | Average posts per DAU | Posts / DAU | 0.20–0.35 | Amber: < 0.15; Red: < 0.10 | Role, topic | Community Ops | Weekly |
| Comments per Post | Average comments per post within 7 days | Comments within 7d / posts | ≥ 3.0 | Amber: 2.0–2.9; Red: < 2.0 | Topic, author role | Community Ops | Weekly |
| Net Helpfulness Score | Net helpfulness per post over 7 days | Helpful minus unhelpful reactions | ≥ +1.0 | Amber: 0.0–0.9; Red: < 0 | Topic, role, verification | Community Ops | Weekly |
| Fact-Check Coverage | Flagged claims annotated within 24h | Annotated claims / flagged claims | ≥ 90% | Amber: 80–89%; Red: < 80% | Topic, severity | Policy Lead | Weekly |
| Correction Adoption Rate | Accepted corrections visible within 24h | Corrected content / content requiring correction | ≥ 85% | Amber: 70–84%; Red: < 70% | Topic, role | Policy Lead | Weekly |
| Time to First Moderator View (Critical) | Minutes from critical report to first moderator view | Minutes elapsed from report creation | ≤ 30 min | Amber: 31–60; Red: > 60 | Severity, time of day | Safety Lead | Daily |
| Report Review SLA (Standard) | Hours to decision for standard reports | Hours elapsed from report creation | ≤ 24 h | Amber: 25–48; Red: > 48 | Category, team | Safety Lead | Daily |
| False Positive Rate (Moderation) | Sanctions overturned on appeal | Overturned / total sanctions | ≤ 5% | Amber: 5.1–8%; Red: > 8% | Category, team | Safety QA | Monthly |
| Re-offense Rate | Sanctioned users who re-offend within 60 days | Re-offenders / sanctioned users | ≤ 10% | Amber: 10.1–15%; Red: > 15% | Category, sanction | Safety QA | Monthly |
| Subscription Conversion | Eligible users starting paid plan within 30 days | New subscribers / eligible users | ≥ 2.5% | Amber: 1.5–2.4%; Red: < 1.5% | Role, region | Monetization Lead | Monthly |
| ARPPU | Average revenue per paying user per month | Revenue from paid users / count of paid users | ≥ $8.00 | Amber: $6.00–7.99; Red: < $6.00 | Plan type, region | Finance | Monthly |
| Ad Fill Rate | Served ad impressions / eligible ad opportunities | Impressions served / eligible opportunities | ≥ 85% | Amber: 70–84%; Red: < 70% | Context, region | Monetization Lead | Weekly |
| Ad Frequency (per user/day) | Average ads per eligible user per day | Ads / eligible user-days | ≤ 2.0 | Amber: 2.1–3.0; Red: > 3.0 | Role, region | Monetization Lead | Weekly |
| Opt-out Rate (Personalized Ads) | Users opting out of personalized ads | Opt-outs / active users | ≤ 10% | Amber: 10.1–15%; Red: > 15% | Region | Privacy Lead | Monthly |
| Consent Coverage | Active users with recorded analytics consent state | Users with consent state / active users | 100% | Amber: 98–99.9%; Red: < 98% | Region | Privacy Lead | Monthly |

Reporting Cadence
- Weekly Ops Review: Growth, engagement, quality, safety, revenue highlights; action items with owners and due dates.
- Monthly Business Review: Trend analysis, budget vs. actuals, experiment outcomes, compliance review notes.
- Quarterly Strategy Review: Deep-dive on mission metrics, risks, policy landscape, and roadmap adjustments.

KPI Governance
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL maintain a metric registry with owner, purpose, definition, lawful basis/consent status, retention period, and version history.
- WHEN a KPI definition changes, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL mark a trend break and attach the new definition version to subsequent reports.
- WHERE a metric is deprecated, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL archive its definition and rationale in the registry.

## 5) Content Quality and Community Health Metrics

Quality and health take precedence over volume. Metrics emphasize constructive engagement and corrective transparency.

EARS Requirements — Quality and Health
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL compute quality metrics using privacy-preserving aggregates and SHALL avoid tracking users across unrelated contexts.
- WHEN a topic’s Net Helpfulness Score remains below 0 for seven consecutive days, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL trigger a community health review with proposed remediation actions.
- WHERE factChecker coverage falls below the alert threshold, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prioritize recruitment or scheduling for fact-checking resources in the affected topics.
- IF a content area exhibits repeated misinformation patterns, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL introduce friction measures (pre-post reminders, source citation prompts) consistent with policy.
- WHEN verifiedMember posts include expert tags, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL present expert context labels to readers.

Additional Health Metrics and Definitions
- Civility Incident Rate: ≤ 1.5% of posts flagged for civility violations per week. Definition: number of posts flagged for civility divided by total posts that week.
- Repeat Correction Visibility: ≥ 95% of accepted corrections remain visible on original content indefinitely. Definition: corrected items with visible corrections / total corrected items.
- Topic Diversity Index: ≥ 0.65 across top 20 topics by volume each quarter. Definition: normalized Shannon diversity index on topic distribution.
- Constructive Participation Ratio: ≥ 85% of comments pass civility and relevance checks in monitored threads (Amber: 75–84%; Red: < 75%).

## 6) Moderation and Safety Metrics

Safety protects discourse quality and user well-being.

EARS Requirements — Moderation and Safety
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prioritize critical severity reports to the front of the queue and SHALL meet the Time to First Moderator View target.
- WHEN a sanction is issued, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL present the policy citation and evidence links to the user at enforcement time.
- WHERE sanctions include temporary restrictions, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL automatically restore privileges upon expiry without further user action.
- IF an appeal is submitted within the allowed window, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL review and decide within 72 hours and SHALL notify the appellant of the outcome and rationale.
- WHEN a moderator action is overturned, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL update the audit trail and recalculate related metrics within 24 hours.

Safety SLA Targets
- Critical Harms (doxxing, threats): First view ≤ 30 minutes; decision ≤ 2 hours.
- Standard Reports: Decision ≤ 24 hours.
- Appeals: Decision ≤ 72 hours; overturn rate ≤ 5%.
- Harm Escalation Rate: ≤ 2% of unresolved P1 items escalate to P0 within 12 hours.

## 7) Governance for Data Use and Ethics

Governance ensures analytics and monetization respect privacy, comply with policy, and preserve civic integrity. Applies to product, monetization, policy, and research uses of data.

Principles
- Data minimization and purpose limitation for analytics and monetization.
- Transparency in user disclosures for ads, sponsorships, and data use.
- No sale of personal data; no political microtargeting based on sensitive attributes.

EARS Requirements — Governance
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL maintain a register of analytics metrics with documented purpose, lawful basis or consent requirement, and retention period.
- WHEN a new metric or experiment requires additional data collection, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL conduct a privacy impact assessment and obtain governance approval before launch.
- WHERE user consent is withdrawn, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL exclude the user’s data from future analytics and SHALL remove the user from longitudinal cohorts within 7 days where legally feasible.
- IF an ethics or compliance breach is suspected, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL initiate an incident review within 24 hours and SHALL notify relevant stakeholders per compliance requirements.
- WHILE a government election moratorium period is active, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL disable political audience refinements and SHALL restrict political ad activations.
- WHERE a KPI or experiment materially affects user rights or safety SLAs, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL escalate to policy governance for pre-approval.

Experimentation Policy
- Pre-registration: hypothesis, metrics (including safety guardrails), eligibility, duration, and stop criteria recorded in the experiment registry.
- Exposure limits: per-user cap of concurrent experiments (e.g., maximum 3) and maximum duration (e.g., 6 weeks) to reduce fatigue and risk.
- Safety guardrails: experiments must not degrade safety metrics beyond predefined bounds (e.g., no more than +10% P1 incidents vs. control).

EARS Requirements — Experimentation
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL require experiment pre-registration including objectives, primary/secondary metrics, and safety guardrails.
- WHEN an experiment begins, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL create a holdback/control cohort and SHALL enforce exposure caps per user.
- IF safety guardrails breach (e.g., P1 incidents +10% vs. control), THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL pause the experiment within 24 hours and initiate a review.
- WHERE experiments affect monetization exposure (ads, sponsorships), THE civicDebateBoard SHALL verify compliance with advertising and sponsorship guardrails before launch.
- WHEN an experiment concludes, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL publish a summary with metric outcomes and decisions in the experiment registry.

Access Governance and Data Ethics
- Role-based data access for analytics respecting least-privilege; aggregated outputs for general stakeholders.
- Retention for analytics datasets aligned to the metric registry; avoid indefinite retention without purpose.

Governance Process Flow

```mermaid
graph LR
  A["Propose Metric/Experiment"] --> B["Document Purpose & Data Needs"]
  B --> C["Privacy Impact Assessment"]
  C --> D{"Approval?"}
  D -->|"Yes"| E["Launch with Guardrails"]
  D -->|"No"| F["Revise or Reject"]
  E --> G["Monitor KPIs & Thresholds"]
  G --> H{"Any Breach or Threshold Crossed?"}
  H -->|"Yes"| I["Incident Review & Mitigation"]
  H -->|"No"| J["Continue & Schedule Review"]
```

Experiment Lifecycle (illustrative)

```mermaid
graph LR
  X1["Pre-Register Hypothesis"] --> X2["Define Success & Safety Bounds"]
  X2 --> X3["Governance Approval"]
  X3 --> X4["Launch & Assign Cohorts"]
  X4 --> X5{"Guardrails Breached?"}
  X5 -->|"Yes"| X6["Pause & Review"]
  X5 -->|"No"| X7["Run to Completion"]
  X6 --> X8["Decide: Modify or Terminate"]
  X7 --> X9["Analyze & Publish Results"]
```

Roles and Responsibilities
- Policy Governance: Approvals, moratorium calendars, ethics reviews.
- Privacy Lead: Consent frameworks, retention, cohort exclusions.
- Product Analytics: KPI catalog integrity, reporting cadences, experiment registry.
- Monetization Lead: Revenue experiments, guardrails, sponsorship/ads compliance.

## 8) Success Metrics and Review Process

Success spans mission impact, sustainable revenue, and community safety. Reviews drive continuous improvement with ethical guardrails.

Mission and Platform Success Metrics (Annual Targets)
- Mission Integrity Index (composite of civility, correction adoption, misinformation mitigation): ≥ 75/100.
- Community Trust (periodic survey): ≥ 70/100 with ≤ 5-point variance across major regions.
- Sustainable Revenue Mix: ≥ 40% subscriptions/sponsorships, ≤ 60% ads.
- Safety Assurance: Meet or exceed all safety SLAs ≥ 95% of the time.
- Experiment Quality Index: ≥ 80/100 weighted by pre-registration, guardrail adherence, and publication completeness.

EARS Requirements — Reviews and Decision-Making
- THE civicDebateBoard SHALL conduct a Weekly Ops Review with published notes, KPI deltas, and assigned actions.
- WHEN a KPI remains in Red for two consecutive periods, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL initiate a corrective action plan with owner, deadline, and expected impact.
- WHERE a revenue initiative degrades the Mission Integrity Index by ≥ 3 points in a month, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL pause the initiative and present a remediation plan before resuming.
- IF quarterly targets are not met for two consecutive quarters, THEN THE civicDebateBoard SHALL run a strategy reset workshop including policy, safety, product, and finance leadership.
- WHILE a corrective action plan is active, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL track leading indicators weekly and SHALL escalate if no improvement is observed within 3 weeks.

Review Artifacts and Cadence
- Weekly Ops Review: Dashboard snapshot, exceptions, actions (owners, due dates).
- Monthly Business Review: Trend narratives, budget outcomes, experiment registry updates, compliance annotations.
- Quarterly Strategy Review: OKR scorecards, policy landscape analysis, risk/contingency updates, revenue mix assessment.

Risk Triggers and Contingencies
- WHERE MAU falls below 60,000 for two months, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL prioritize retention initiatives over acquisition experiments for the next quarter.
- WHERE False Positive Rate exceeds 8% in a month, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL conduct a moderation QA calibration within 14 days.
- WHERE Opt-out Rate for personalized ads exceeds 15% in any region, THE civicDebateBoard SHALL limit personalization levers and review disclosure clarity within 30 days.

## Appendices

A. Privacy and Non-Functional Alignment
- Requirements align with consent expectations in the [Non-Functional Requirements and SLAs](./08-non-functional-requirements-and-slas.md). Any analytics requiring consent must honor consent state and applicable regulations without exception.

B. Business-Only Scope
- Business objectives, measurable KPIs, ethical guardrails, and review cadences are specified. Technical implementation (data models, API design, analytics tools, storage, dashboarding) remains at the development team’s discretion.

C. Role Considerations for Metrics
- member: Included in growth and engagement KPIs; standard rate limits apply.
- verifiedMember: Segmented in quality metrics and expert-tag analyses; adjusted rate limits per policy.
- factChecker: Tracked for fact-check coverage and correction adoption; no sanction authority.
- moderator: Accountable for safety SLAs and appeal turnaround.
- admin: Accountable for governance approvals, monetization guardrails, and cross-functional reviews.

models.name: civicdebateboard_tags

models.name: civicdebateboard_post_topics

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: civicdebateboard_category_changes
models.description: Audit log of moderator/admin-driven reclassification events for {@link civicdebateboard_posts}: captures movement from one {@link civicdebateboard_categories} to another, the acting user, and optional linkage to a moderation case. foreignFields.name: from_category_id
foreignFields.description: Original category prior to the change. Target model's {@link civicdebateboard_categories.id}.

models.name: civicdebateboard_content_warnings
models.description: Controlled list of content warning types (e.g., sensitive, graphic) that can be applied to {@link civicdebateboard_posts}. This table defines the warning taxonomy; assignments to posts are maintained in {@link civicdebateboard_post_content_warnings}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable code identifying the warning type (unique business identifier).

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Optional ordinal indicating relative severity for ordering (higher means more severe).

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: civicdebateboard_post_content_warnings
models.description: Junction table linking {@link civicdebateboard_posts} and {@link civicdebateboard_content_warnings} to assign one or more content warnings to posts. foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_content_warning_id
foreignFields.description: Associated content warning. Target model's {@link civicdebateboard_content_warnings.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Assignment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the assignment.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the assignment is removed but retained for audit.

models.name: civicdebateboard_threads
models.description: Discussion thread container. Each thread groups one root post and all descendant comments. Maintains locking state and ownership metadata. The root post is uniquely referenced via {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id} when set. Posts reference this model via {@link civicdebateboard_posts.thread_id}.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Whether the thread is locked for new comments and edits by non-staff.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the thread.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the thread record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_posts
models.description: Root discussion items authored by users. Belong to a {@link civicdebateboard_threads} and exactly one taxonomy category (FK to {@link civicdebateboard_categories}). Supports expert tagging for verified members. Edit history captured in {@link civicdebateboard_post_edits}. State transitions logged in {@link civicdebateboard_content_states}. Added an index on (expert_tagged, created_at) to support expert-content discovery and listings.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title (business validation 10–150 chars enforced in application).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content body (business validation 20–50,000 chars enforced in application).

plainFields.name: expert_tagged
plainFields.description: Whether the post is marked as expert content by a verified member or admin.

plainFields.name: expertise_note
plainFields.description: Short expertise context note provided when expert_tagged is true (policy-defined length).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the post.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the post record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_comments
models.description: Replies within a thread associated to a specific {@link civicdebateboard_posts}. Supports hierarchical replies via optional parent self-reference. Edit history captured in {@link civicdebateboard_comment_edits}. State transitions logged in {@link civicdebateboard_content_states}. Added an index on (parent_id, created_at) to optimize reply pagination.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id} for nested replies.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment content body (business validation 1–20,000 chars enforced in application).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the comment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the comment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_post_edits
models.description: Immutable snapshot of a post edit. Captures the edited content version, optional category at edit time, who edited, and when. Enables audit trails and restoration without denormalizing into the main entity. Related post: {@link civicdebateboard_posts}.

foreignFields.name: snapshot_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category at the time of this edit. References {@link civicdebateboard_categories.id}. Optional because category changes may be tracked elsewhere.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Edited post title at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Edited post body at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: expert_tagged
plainFields.description: Expert tag value at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: expertise_note
plainFields.description: Expertise note value at this snapshot (if any).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Editor-provided reason for the edit, if supplied.

plainFields.name: material
plainFields.description: Whether the edit is considered material/significant under policy (affects visibility/rereview).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Edit snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Technical update timestamp for the snapshot record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp of the snapshot record, if ever retracted.

models.name: civicdebateboard_comment_edits
models.description: Immutable snapshot of a comment edit. Captures edited content, who edited, and when for auditability. Related comment: {@link civicdebateboard_comments}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Edited comment body at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Editor-provided reason for the edit, if supplied.

plainFields.name: material
plainFields.description: Whether the edit is considered material/significant under policy (affects rereview).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Edit snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Technical update timestamp for the snapshot record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp of the snapshot record, if applicable.

models.name: civicdebateboard_attachments
models.description: File attachments associated with either a {@link civicdebateboard_posts} or a {@link civicdebateboard_comments}. foreignFields.name: post_id

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id} when the attachment belongs to a comment.

plainFields.name: file_uri
plainFields.description: Canonical URI to the stored file (object storage, CDN, etc.).

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the stored file.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Accessibility alt text (required by policy for images; optional for non-image files).

plainFields.name: size_bytes
plainFields.description: File size in bytes for quota and validation purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Attachment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the attachment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_content_states
models.description: Temporal log of content visibility and enforcement states for posts and comments. Records who applied the state, human-readable reason, and visibility flags. Latest state is determined at query time or external materialized views. Targets one of {@link civicdebateboard_posts} or {@link civicdebateboard_comments}. Added composite indexes on (state, created_at) and (visibility, created_at) for operational queries.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id} when the state applies to a post.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id} when the state applies to a comment.

foreignFields.name: applied_by_user_id
foreignFields.description: Actor user's {@link civicdebateboard_users.id} who applied the state (moderator/admin or system).

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Business state code (e.g., draft, published, pending_review, locked, soft_deleted, removed_by_policy, under_moderation_hold).

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility mode for readers (e.g., public, limited, hidden).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Human-readable reason or policy reference for this state change.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Whether this state enforces a lock on edits/comments for the target item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this state was applied.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Technical update timestamp for the state record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for erroneous or retracted state records, if any.

models.name: civicdebateboard_mentions
models.description: User mention occurrences extracted from posts or comments. Stores the resolved mentioned user and the literal handle captured. foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Source post's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id} when the mention appears in a post.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Source comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id} when the mention appears in a comment.

plainFields.name: mentioned_handle

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Technical update timestamp for the mention record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: civicdebateboard_reaction_types
models.description: Catalog of allowed reaction kinds (e.g., agree, insightful, respectful) available across the platform. Centralizes human-readable labels and a stable machine code used by clients. plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the reaction type.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_reactions
models.description: User-applied non-vote reactions on posts or comments (e.g., agree, insightful). Each row represents a single user’s reaction instance. Enforces one reaction per (user, item, type) by composite unique constraints. Exactly one of {@link civicdebateboard_reactions.civicdebateboard_post_id} or {@link civicdebateboard_reactions.civicdebateboard_comment_id} must be non-null (business rule enforced at application/service layer). Relates to {@link civicdebateboard_users}, {@link civicdebateboard_posts}, {@link civicdebateboard_comments}, and {@link civicdebateboard_reaction_types}.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment’s {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id}. Exactly one of post or comment must be set.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the reaction record (e.g., moderation adjustment).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_votes
models.description: Binary or directional votes (e.g., upvote/downvote) applied by users to posts or comments. Enforces one vote per (user, item). The direction field captures +1 for upvote and −1 for downvote. Exactly one of {@link civicdebateboard_votes.civicdebateboard_post_id} or {@link civicdebateboard_votes.civicdebateboard_comment_id} must be non-null (business rule enforced at application/service layer). Relates to {@link civicdebateboard_users}, {@link civicdebateboard_posts}, and {@link civicdebateboard_comments}.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post’s {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id}. Exactly one of post or comment must be set.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment’s {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id}. Exactly one of post or comment must be set.

plainFields.name: direction

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the vote.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the vote record (e.g., moderation adjustment).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_claim_excerpts
models.description: Anchored factual claim excerpts selected from user-generated content for evidence-first fact checking. Exactly one of post or comment should be set by business rule (enforced at application level).

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Source post for the claim selection. Target model's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Source comment for the claim selection. Target model's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id}.

plainFields.name: start_offset
plainFields.description: Zero-based character index where the selection starts within the source content snapshot.

plainFields.name: end_offset
plainFields.description: Zero-based character index where the selection ends (exclusive) within the source content snapshot. Must be >= start_offset.

plainFields.name: excerpt_text
plainFields.description: Exact text of the selected claim excerpt preserved for audit and review context.

plainFields.name: context_before
plainFields.description: Optional nearby text that precedes the excerpt to aid reviewer context (may be truncated).

plainFields.name: context_after
plainFields.description: Optional nearby text that follows the excerpt to aid reviewer context (may be truncated).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

plainFields.name: enforcement_affecting

plainFields.name: proposed_label
plainFields.description: Optional proposed policy label (e.g., "reduce_distribution", "age_gate", "remove_content").

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

models.name: civicdebateboard_annotation_sources

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Optional display title of the source material.

plainFields.name: publisher

plainFields.name: accessed_at
plainFields.description: Optional date/time when the source was last accessed or verified by the reviewer.

plainFields.name: archived_url
plainFields.description: Optional archive URL or snapshot reference used to preserve evidence.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

models.name: civicdebateboard_annotation_reviews

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional reviewer notes that summarize rationale and references for the decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

models.name: civicdebateboard_annotation_status_changes

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable reason or note for the transition.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

models.description: Per-user notification preferences controlling delivery channels, bundling, digest scheduling, and quiet hours. foreignFields.description: Owner user's {@link civicdebateboard_users.id}. Exactly one preferences row per user.

plainFields.name: default_delivery_mode

plainFields.name: enable_in_app

models.name: civicdebateboard_notifications
models.description: User-facing notification records representing events like replies, mentions, moderation decisions, appeals, annotations, or other system updates. Each notification belongs to a recipient {@link civicdebateboard_users} and may reference related domain objects for context. Optionally linked to a {@link civicdebateboard_digests} when delivered in a batch.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Related post's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id} when the notification concerns a post.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Related comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id} when the notification concerns a comment or reply.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_thread_id
foreignFields.description: Related thread's {@link civicdebateboard_threads.id} when the notification is thread-scoped.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Related moderation action's {@link civicdebateboard_moderation_actions.id} for enforcement outcomes.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_appeal_decision_id
foreignFields.description: Related appeal decision's {@link civicdebateboard_appeal_decisions.id} when appeals resolve.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_annotation_id
foreignFields.description: Related annotation's {@link civicdebateboard_annotations.id} for fact-check visibility or status changes.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_report_id
foreignFields.description: Related report's {@link civicdebateboard_reports.id} for report acknowledgements or outcomes.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_digest_id
foreignFields.description: Linked digest's {@link civicdebateboard_digests.id} when the notification is delivered within a digest.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Business category for the notification (e.g., reply, mention, moderation_decision, appeal_result, annotation_published).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short subject or title shown to the user when applicable.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Human-readable body text for the notification when applicable.

plainFields.name: delivery_mode
plainFields.description: Delivery mode used: "instant" or "digest" at the time of send.

plainFields.name: channel
plainFields.description: Channel used to deliver the notification (e.g., in_app, email, push).

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Time the notification was sent via its channel. Null for pending items.

plainFields.name: read_at

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

plainFields.name: error_code

plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: civicdebateboard_subscriptions
models.description: Subscriber-level configuration for content updates independent of specific targets. A subscription belongs to a {@link civicdebateboard_users} account and defines preferences such as delivery mode and whether it participates in digests. Specific targets (authors, threads, posts, topics, categories) are attached via {@link civicdebateboard_subscription_targets}. Enforces at most one subscription per user per delivery mode to prevent duplication across targets.

plainFields.name: delivery_mode
plainFields.description: Preferred delivery mode for this subscription (e.g., instant or digest).

plainFields.name: muted
plainFields.description: Whether notifications from targets under this subscription are muted.

plainFields.name: digest_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this subscription contributes items to periodic digests.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the subscription is currently active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

models.name: civicdebateboard_subscription_targets
models.description: Junction table linking a {@link civicdebateboard_subscriptions} record to one specific target entity. Supports multiple target kinds via nullable foreign keys with strong referential integrity (author user, thread, post, topic, category). The target_type classifier aids routing and analytics while remaining non-authoritative compared to FKs.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_user_id
foreignFields.description: Target author user's {@link civicdebateboard_users.id} when following an author.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_thread_id
foreignFields.description: Target thread's {@link civicdebateboard_threads.id} when following a thread.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id} when following a post.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_topic_id
foreignFields.description: Target topic's {@link civicdebateboard_topics.id} when following a topic.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_category_id
foreignFields.description: Target category's {@link civicdebateboard_categories.id} when following a category.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Classifier for the target kind (author, thread, post, topic, category) to simplify routing and analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

models.name: civicdebateboard_bookmarks
models.description: Bookmarks created by a user to quickly return to important civic content. A bookmark targets either a {@link civicdebateboard_posts} record or a {@link civicdebateboard_comments} record (exactly one must be set at application level). Prevents duplicates per user and target via composite unique constraints. No denormalized content fields are stored; discovery uses joins. Supports audit via temporal fields.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Bookmarked post's {@link civicdebateboard_posts.id}. Nullable when the bookmark targets a comment.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Bookmarked comment's {@link civicdebateboard_comments.id}. Nullable when the bookmark targets a post.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the bookmark was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the bookmark was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the bookmark was removed by the user or system. Null when active.

models.name: civicdebateboard_author_follows
models.description: Directed follow relationship where one user (follower) subscribes to another user's public activity (followee). Both sides reference {@link civicdebateboard_users}. Prevents duplicate follows via composite unique constraint. Used to personalize feeds and notifications without duplicating profile data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the follow was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the follow record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the follow was unfollowed (null when active).

models.name: civicdebateboard_topic_follows
models.description: Follow relationship where a user subscribes to updates from a specific {@link civicdebateboard_topics} entity. Enables personalized feeds and notifications for topic changes without denormalizing topic data.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the topic follow was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the topic follow was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the topic follow was removed (null when active).

models.description: Per-user per-category digest preference for receiving batched updates about a {@link civicdebateboard_categories} node. Stores only raw preference fields (enabled and cadence). Delivery scheduling and sending are handled by notification/digest components.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the digest is enabled for this user and category.

plainFields.name: cadence
plainFields.description: Preferred digest frequency. Recommended values: "daily" or "weekly". Stored as string for flexibility; validated in application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the digest preference was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the digest preference was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: civicdebateboard_user_mutes
models.description: User-configured visibility mutes that reduce exposure to content from either a muted author ({@link civicdebateboard_users}) or a muted topic ({@link civicdebateboard_topics}). foreignFields.name: muted_civicdebateboard_user_id
foreignFields.description: Muted author's {@link civicdebateboard_users.id}. Nullable when the mute targets a topic.

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_topic_id
foreignFields.description: Muted topic's {@link civicdebateboard_topics.id}. Nullable when the mute targets an author.

plainFields.name: muted_until
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp after which the mute should automatically lapse. Null for indefinite mutes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the mute was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the mute was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the mute was removed (null when active).

foreignFields.name: civicdebateboard_session_id
foreignFields.description: Related session's {@link civicdebateboard_sessions.id} if the action occurred within a session context.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Semantic action name (e.g., login, logout_all, role_change, sanction_issue).

plainFields.name: target_type

plainFields.name: outcome

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

### `civicdebateboard_configurations`

System-wide configuration records expressed as scoped key-value pairs
with effective time windows. Other services read these to drive behavior
(e.g., rate limits, guardrails) without code changes. Records are
authored by administrators; historical states are retained via soft
delete and effective windows. References authoring users via {@link
civicdebateboard_users}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Authoring user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `updated_by_user_id`: Last updating user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `key`
  > Business configuration key identifier within a scope. Examples:
  > "rate_limits.post.create", "safety.moderation.enabled".
- `value`
  > Configuration value stored as string. Application interprets typed
  > semantics (e.g., JSON, number, boolean) externally.
- `scope`
  > Logical scope of the configuration (e.g., "global", "env:prod",
  > "region:KR"). Enables parallel keys per scope.
- `description`: Human-readable explanation of the configuration and its intended effect.
- `effective_from`
  > When this configuration becomes effective. Used for rollout scheduling
  > and audit context.
- `effective_to`: Optional end time after which the configuration is no longer effective.
- `active`
  > Whether this configuration is considered active by control planes. Allows
  > pre-seeding or retiring values.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_feature_toggles`

Feature flag definitions controlling progressive delivery and conditional
behavior across the platform. Supports scoped flags, partial rollouts,
and segmentation. Consumed by application services at read-time; authored
by administrators. References [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) for
authorship. rollout_percentage is validated by application/business logic
to be within [0, 100].

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Authoring user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `updated_by_user_id`: Last updating user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `code`: Stable machine-readable flag code. Example: "posts.pre_moderation".
- `name`: Human-friendly name of the feature toggle.
- `description`
  > Detailed description explaining the flag purpose and safety
  > considerations.
- `enabled`: Primary on/off switch for the feature under the given scope.
- `rollout_percentage`
  > Percentage-based rollout for gradual exposure (0–100).
  > Application/business logic enforces bounds.
- `target_segment`
  > Optional audience or rule expression used to segment exposure (e.g.,
  > role, region).
- `scope`: Logical scope of the flag (e.g., "global", "env:staging", "region:KR").
- `start_at`: Optional scheduled start for automatic enablement.
- `end_at`: Optional scheduled end for automatic disablement.
- `kill_switch`: Emergency kill switch default for safe rollback post-incident.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the toggle is retired.

### `civicdebateboard_policy_versions`

Versioned policy documents (e.g., moderation, privacy, safety) with
explicit lifecycle states and effective windows. Each row represents an
immutable version for a specific policy_code. Approval references the
responsible user in [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `approved_by_user_id`
  > Approver user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users). Optional for
  > drafts/unapproved versions.
- `created_by_user_id`: Authoring user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `updated_by_user_id`: Last updating user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `policy_code`: Stable identifier of the policy domain (e.g., "moderation", "privacy").
- `version`
  > Monotonic version number for the given policy_code. Combined with
  > policy_code to form a unique version.
- `status`: Lifecycle status string (e.g., "draft", "active", "deprecated").
- `title`: Human-readable title of the policy version.
- `body_uri`: URI pointing to the canonical policy body content (e.g., HTML/Markdown).
- `effective_from`: Start of the time window when this version is effective.
- `effective_to`: Optional end of the effective time window.
- `notes`: Author or reviewer notes regarding changes or rationale.
- `approval_notes`: Approver notes or conditions attached during approval.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retired records.

### `civicdebateboard_sanction_catalogs`

Catalog of sanction types available to moderation workflows, including
default durations and severity calibration. Used to ensure consistent
enforcement decisions across cases. Authored by admins; referenced across
[civicdebateboard_moderation_actions](#civicdebateboard_moderation_actions) and related entities
conceptually (foreign keys not required here).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Authoring user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `updated_by_user_id`: Last updating user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `code`: Stable sanction code (e.g., "warning", "mute_24h", "suspension_7d").
- `name`: Human-friendly label for the sanction type.
- `description`: Explanation of when and how this sanction should be used, per policy.
- `default_duration_hours`: Default duration in hours to apply when not overridden by case context.
- `max_duration_hours`: Maximum permissible duration in hours for this sanction type.
- `severity_level`: Normalized severity level for calibration and escalation (e.g., 0–3).
- `applies_to_roles`
  > Comma-separated role names indicating applicability (e.g.,
  > "member,verifiedMember"). Purely informational.
- `policy_category`
  > Optional linking text to the policy category this sanction addresses
  > (business label, not FK).
- `active`: Whether this catalog entry is active and available for selection.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for deprecation without loss of history.

### `civicdebateboard_election_windows`

Time-bounded elevated-protection windows for civic events (e.g.,
elections) by region. Used to prioritize moderation SLAs and apply
special safeguards. The active field is not a computed value; it is an
operator-controlled state (or maintained by a scheduler) persisted for
operational control, not a derived/calculated column. Configured by
admins and referenced by moderation and notification systems.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Authoring user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `updated_by_user_id`: Last updating user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `region_code`
  > Region or jurisdiction code (e.g., ISO 3166-2 or service-defined region
  > identifier).
- `name`: Human-friendly name of the election window or civic event.
- `description`: Detailed context of the event and applicable safeguards.
- `starts_at`: Start datetime of the elevated-protection period.
- `ends_at`: End datetime of the elevated-protection period.
- `active`
  > Operator-controlled flag indicating whether this window is currently
  > active. Not a derived/calculated field.
- `priority_tier`
  > Optional priority tier for routing (lower number indicates higher
  > priority).
- `reference_uri`: Optional reference URL with authoritative information about the event.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if this window is withdrawn.

### `civicdebateboard_users`

Canonical user account record for the civicDebateBoard platform. Stores
authentication identifiers and core lifecycle flags. Related entities
include profile [civicdebateboard_user_profiles](#civicdebateboard_user_profiles), preferences
[civicdebateboard_user_preferences](#civicdebateboard_user_preferences), devices {@link
civicdebateboard_user_devices}, sessions {@link
civicdebateboard_sessions}, consents {@link
civicdebateboard_user_consents}, and role overlays {@link
civicdebateboard_members}, [civicdebateboard_verifiedmembers](#civicdebateboard_verifiedmembers),
[civicdebateboard_factcheckers](#civicdebateboard_factcheckers), {@link
civicdebateboard_moderators}, [civicdebateboard_admins](#civicdebateboard_admins).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > User's unique email address used for account communications and
  > credential login.
- `password_hash`
  > Hashed password string (never store plaintext). Managed by authentication
  > flows and rotation policies.
- `handle`
  > Public handle/username for mentions and discovery. Must be unique and
  > conform to allowed handle rules defined at the application layer.
- `email_verified`
  > Whether the user's email address has been verified via the verification
  > flow.
- `status`
  > Current account status in business terms (e.g., registered_unverified,
  > active, muted, suspended, banned). Used for gating actions alongside
  > sanctions.
- `last_login_at`: Timestamp of the most recent successful login for this account.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the account is deactivated/removed while
  > retaining auditability.

### `civicdebateboard_user_profiles`

Per-user profile information (1:1) separated from credentials. Stores
public display attributes and locale/timezone preferences for
presentation. Linked to [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `display_name`: Public display name shown to readers. May duplicate or differ from handle.
- `bio`: Optional biography or description provided by the user.
- `avatar_uri`: Optional URI to the user's avatar image.
- `timezone`
  > Preferred timezone identifier (e.g., Asia/Seoul) used for displaying
  > local times.
- `locale`: Preferred locale/language tag for UI rendering (e.g., en-US, ko-KR).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for profile data.

### `civicdebateboard_user_preferences`

Per-user preference settings (1:1) for content, localization, and
communication behaviors. Separate from notification-specific preferences
which are modeled elsewhere. Linked to [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `timezone`
  > Preferred timezone identifier for quiet hours and schedule interpretation
  > (e.g., Asia/Seoul).
- `locale`: Preferred locale for UI text and formatting (e.g., en-US).
- `quiet_hours_start`: Optional quiet hours start marker in local time (e.g., 22:00).
- `quiet_hours_end`: Optional quiet hours end marker in local time (e.g., 07:00).
- `content_sensitive_opt_in`: Whether the user opts in to view sensitive content after warnings.
- `marketing_emails_opt_in`
  > Whether the user opts in to receive marketing emails subject to consent
  > policies.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for preference record.

### `civicdebateboard_user_devices`

Registered devices for a user, used for session association, revocation,
and trusted-MFA behavior. Many devices per {@link
civicdebateboard_users}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `device_name`: Human-readable device name or label (e.g., "Alice’s iPhone").
- `user_agent`: Captured user agent string for the device when available.
- `ip`: Most recent IP observed for activity on this device (string form).
- `trusted`: Whether the device has been marked trusted for MFA skip windows.
- `last_seen_at`: Last activity observed for this device.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for device record.

### `civicdebateboard_sessions`

Authenticated login sessions for users with device linkage. Enhanced to
enforce refresh token reuse detection and efficient cleanup by indexing
expiration times. Belongs to [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) and
optionally [civicdebateboard_user_devices](#civicdebateboard_user_devices). Stores token lifetimes,
rotation identifiers, and activity timestamps for revocation and audit.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_user_device_id`: Associated device's [civicdebateboard_user_devices.id](#civicdebateboard_user_devices) when known.
- `session_identifier`: Opaque unique identifier for session management UI and audits.
- `refresh_token_jti`
  > Refresh token JTI for rotation and reuse detection. Now unique to prevent
  > duplicates across sessions.
- `access_expires_at`: Expiration time of the access token associated with this session.
- `refresh_expires_at`: Expiration time of the refresh token (max lifetime) for this session.
- `last_seen_at`: Most recent authenticated activity timestamp for this session.
- `ip`: Most recent IP associated with this session.
- `mfa_trusted`: Whether MFA was trusted on this device for the allowed window.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for revoked/expired archival.

### `civicdebateboard_user_consents`

Purpose-specific consent records for privacy compliance. Maintains
historical states (granted/withdrawn) for each purpose per {@link

business logic.

Properties as follows:

- `approved_by_user_id`
  > Approver's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) (typically a
  > moderator/admin).
- `assigned_at`: Timestamp when fact checker role was granted.
- `scope_note`: Optional scope or domain note (e.g., health policy, elections).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for fact checker role (revocation).

### `civicdebateboard_moderators`

Role overlay for moderator accounts. 1:1 with {@link
civicdebateboard_users}. Includes approval metadata and moderation scope
attributes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Moderator's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `approved_by_user_id`: Approver's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) (typically an admin).
- `assigned_at`: Timestamp when moderator role was granted.
- `level`: Moderator level or tier for scope/elevation (e.g., 1 basic, 2 senior).
- `jurisdiction`: Optional jurisdiction or area of responsibility (e.g., region, topic).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for moderator role (revocation).

### `civicdebateboard_admins`

Role overlay for administrator accounts. 1:1 with {@link
civicdebateboard_users}. Highest authority for platform governance.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Administrator's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `assigned_at`: Timestamp when administrator role was granted.
- `super_admin`: Whether the admin has super-administrator privileges (full governance).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for administrator role (revocation).

### `civicdebateboard_user_mfa_methods`

Per-user MFA configuration storing enablement state, encrypted secret
material for TOTP, and backup code hashes with rotation history. Provides
the authoritative source to fulfill MFA requirements (enable/disable,
recovery codes, rotation timestamps) for [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users).
Access to secret material must be restricted at the application level and
stored/handled securely.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `enabled`: Whether MFA is enabled for this user.
- `totp_secret_encrypted`
  > Encrypted TOTP secret material (ciphertext or KMS reference).
  > Application-layer encryption and key management are required.
- `backup_codes_hash`
  > Hashed backup codes set (opaque string or serialized list of hashed
  > codes). Do not store plaintext codes.
- `backup_codes_remaining`: Count of remaining (unused) backup codes for this user.
- `last_verified_at`: Timestamp of the last successful MFA verification for audit.
- `last_rotated_at`: Timestamp when TOTP secret or backup codes were last rotated.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when MFA is fully decommissioned.

### `civicdebateboard_categories`

Curated taxonomy node representing a category that every {@link
civicdebateboard_posts} must belong to. Categories are managed by
administrators for coherent organization and discovery. This model stores
only category attributes (3NF) while assignments to posts are enforced in
[civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Stable human-readable code for the category (unique business identifier)
  > used in URLs and administrative operations.
- `name`: Display name of the category for end users.
- `description`: Optional description explaining the category’s scope and usage guidelines.
- `active`: Whether the category is currently active and selectable for new posts.
- `position`: Ordering position for category listings in administrative or UI contexts.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the category is retired but retained for
  > audit.

### `civicdebateboard_topics`

Followable thematic grouping used to associate {@link
civicdebateboard_posts} for discovery and notifications. Topics can be
deprecated without deletion to preserve historical associations.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`: Stable human-readable code for the topic (unique business identifier).
- `name`: Display name of the topic.
- `description`: Optional description providing context and scoping for the topic.
- `active`: Whether the topic is active for new associations and follows.
- `deprecated`
  > Whether the topic is deprecated (no new associations) while preserving
  > historical links.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the topic is removed from active use.

### `civicdebateboard_tags`

Keyword labels applied to [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts). Tags may be
controlled (curated) or free-form (normalized). This model contains only
tag attributes; post associations are managed in {@link
civicdebateboard_post_tags}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`
  > Canonical tag name. Enforced unique to avoid duplicates and ensure
  > consistent discovery.
- `description`: Optional description or curation note for the tag.
- `controlled`: Whether the tag selection is controlled/curated by admins.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for deprecating a tag.

### `civicdebateboard_post_topics`

Junction table linking [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) and {@link
civicdebateboard_topics} to realize many-to-many associations between
posts and topics for discovery and subscriptions. Contains only
relational keys and timestamps (3NF). Uniqueness is soft-delete-aware to
allow re-association after prior soft-deleted rows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Associated post. Target model's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `civicdebateboard_topic_id`: Associated topic. Target model's [civicdebateboard_topics.id](#civicdebateboard_topics).
- `created_at`: Association creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the association.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the association is removed but retained for
  > audit.

### `civicdebateboard_post_tags`

Junction table linking [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) and {@link
civicdebateboard_tags} to realize many-to-many tag assignments per post.
Stores only relational keys and timestamps for audit and soft deletion.
Uniqueness is soft-delete-aware to allow re-association after prior
soft-deleted rows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Associated post. Target model's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `civicdebateboard_tag_id`: Associated tag. Target model's [civicdebateboard_tags.id](#civicdebateboard_tags).
- `created_at`: Assignment creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the assignment.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the assignment is removed but retained for
  > audit.

### `civicdebateboard_category_changes`

Audit log of moderator/admin-driven reclassification events for {@link
civicdebateboard_posts}: captures movement from one {@link
civicdebateboard_categories} to another, the acting user, and optional
linkage to a moderation case. Preserves historical traceability without
duplicating post or category attributes (strict 3NF).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Reclassified post. Target model's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `from_category_id`
  > Original category prior to the change. Target model's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_categories.id}.
- `to_category_id`
  > New category after the change. Target model's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_categories.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`
  > Actor who performed the reclassification (moderator/admin). Target
  > model's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_moderation_case_id`
  > Optional linkage to the moderation case for governance and audit. Target
  > model's [civicdebateboard_moderation_cases.id](#civicdebateboard_moderation_cases).
- `reason`
  > Human-readable rationale or policy reference summary for the category
  > change.
- `created_at`: Event creation timestamp (when the change was recorded).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this log entry (e.g., reason amendment).
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the log entry is hidden but retained for
  > audit.

### `civicdebateboard_content_warnings`

Controlled list of content warning types (e.g., sensitive, graphic) that
can be applied to [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts). This table defines the
warning taxonomy; assignments to posts are maintained in {@link
civicdebateboard_post_content_warnings}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`: Stable code identifying the warning type (unique business identifier).
- `name`: Display name of the warning type.
- `description`: Optional description providing guidance on when to apply this warning.
- `active`: Whether the warning type is currently available for selection.
- `severity`
  > Optional ordinal indicating relative severity for ordering (higher means
  > more severe).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the warning type is retired but retained for
  > audit.

### `civicdebateboard_post_content_warnings`

Junction table linking [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) and {@link
civicdebateboard_content_warnings} to assign one or more content warnings
to posts. Pure M:N association with audit timestamps; no denormalized
attributes. Uniqueness is soft-delete-aware to allow re-association after
prior soft-deleted rows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Associated post. Target model's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `civicdebateboard_content_warning_id`
  > Associated content warning. Target model's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_content_warnings.id}.
- `created_at`: Assignment creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the assignment.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the assignment is removed but retained for
  > audit.
