### `civicdebateboard_threads`

Discussion thread container. Each thread groups one root post and all
descendant comments. Maintains locking state and ownership metadata. The
root post is uniquely referenced via [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts)
when set. Posts reference this model via {@link
civicdebateboard_posts.thread_id}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Creator's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `locked`: Whether the thread is locked for new comments and edits by non-staff.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the thread.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the thread record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

### `civicdebateboard_posts`

Root discussion items authored by users. Belong to a {@link
civicdebateboard_threads} and exactly one taxonomy category (FK to {@link
civicdebateboard_categories}). Supports expert tagging for verified
members. Edit history captured in [civicdebateboard_post_edits](#civicdebateboard_post_edits).
State transitions logged in [civicdebateboard_content_states](#civicdebateboard_content_states).
Added an index on (expert_tagged, created_at) to support expert-content
discovery and listings.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `thread_id`: Belonged thread's [civicdebateboard_threads.id](#civicdebateboard_threads)
- `author_user_id`: Author user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users)
- `category_id`: Chosen category's [civicdebateboard_categories.id](#civicdebateboard_categories)
- `title`: Post title (business validation 10–150 chars enforced in application).
- `body`
  > Main content body (business validation 20–50,000 chars enforced in
  > application).
- `expert_tagged`
  > Whether the post is marked as expert content by a verified member or
  > admin.
- `expertise_note`
  > Short expertise context note provided when expert_tagged is true
  > (policy-defined length).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the post.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the post record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

### `civicdebateboard_comments`

Replies within a thread associated to a specific {@link
civicdebateboard_posts}. Supports hierarchical replies via optional
parent self-reference. Edit history captured in {@link
civicdebateboard_comment_edits}. State transitions logged in {@link
civicdebateboard_content_states}. Added an index on (parent_id,
created_at) to optimize reply pagination.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`: Parent post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts)
- `parent_id`
  > Optional parent comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments) for nested
  > replies.
- `author_user_id`: Author user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users)
- `body`
  > Comment content body (business validation 1–20,000 chars enforced in
  > application).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the comment.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the comment record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

### `civicdebateboard_post_edits`

Immutable snapshot of a post edit. Captures the edited content version,
optional category at edit time, who edited, and when. Enables audit
trails and restoration without denormalizing into the main entity.
Related post: [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`: Edited post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `editor_user_id`: Editor actor's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `snapshot_category_id`
  > Category at the time of this edit. References {@link
  > civicdebateboard_categories.id}. Optional because category changes may be
  > tracked elsewhere.
- `title`: Edited post title at this snapshot.
- `body`: Edited post body at this snapshot.
- `expert_tagged`: Expert tag value at this snapshot.
- `expertise_note`: Expertise note value at this snapshot (if any).
- `reason`: Editor-provided reason for the edit, if supplied.
- `material`
  > Whether the edit is considered material/significant under policy (affects
  > visibility/rereview).
- `created_at`: Edit snapshot creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Technical update timestamp for the snapshot record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp of the snapshot record, if ever retracted.

### `civicdebateboard_comment_edits`

Immutable snapshot of a comment edit. Captures edited content, who
edited, and when for auditability. Related comment: {@link
civicdebateboard_comments}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `comment_id`: Edited comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments).
- `editor_user_id`: Editor actor's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `body`: Edited comment body at this snapshot.
- `reason`: Editor-provided reason for the edit, if supplied.
- `material`
  > Whether the edit is considered material/significant under policy (affects
  > rereview).
- `created_at`: Edit snapshot creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Technical update timestamp for the snapshot record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp of the snapshot record, if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_attachments`

File attachments associated with either a [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts)
or a [civicdebateboard_comments](#civicdebateboard_comments). Stores only raw metadata (URI,
mime type, size) and uploader identity. Accessibility alt_text is stored
and may be mandated by policy for images. No binary content is stored
here.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > Parent post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts) when the attachment
  > belongs to a post.
- `comment_id`
  > Parent comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments) when the attachment
  > belongs to a comment.
- `uploader_user_id`: Uploader user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `file_uri`: Canonical URI to the stored file (object storage, CDN, etc.).
- `mime_type`: MIME type of the stored file.
- `alt_text`
  > Accessibility alt text (required by policy for images; optional for
  > non-image files).
- `size_bytes`: File size in bytes for quota and validation purposes.
- `created_at`: Attachment creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the attachment record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

### `civicdebateboard_content_states`

Temporal log of content visibility and enforcement states for posts and
comments. Records who applied the state, human-readable reason, and
visibility flags. Latest state is determined at query time or external
materialized views. Targets one of [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) or
[civicdebateboard_comments](#civicdebateboard_comments). Added composite indexes on (state,
created_at) and (visibility, created_at) for operational queries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > Target post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts) when the state applies to
  > a post.
- `comment_id`
  > Target comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments) when the state
  > applies to a comment.
- `applied_by_user_id`
  > Actor user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) who applied the state
  > (moderator/admin or system).
- `state`
  > Business state code (e.g., draft, published, pending_review, locked,
  > soft_deleted, removed_by_policy, under_moderation_hold).
- `visibility`: Visibility mode for readers (e.g., public, limited, hidden).
- `reason`: Human-readable reason or policy reference for this state change.
- `locked`: Whether this state enforces a lock on edits/comments for the target item.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this state was applied.
- `updated_at`: Technical update timestamp for the state record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for erroneous or retracted state records, if any.

### `civicdebateboard_mentions`

User mention occurrences extracted from posts or comments. Stores the
resolved mentioned user and the literal handle captured. Prevents
duplicate mentions per target and supports search over handles. Targets
one of [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) or {@link
civicdebateboard_comments}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > Source post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts) when the mention appears
  > in a post.
- `comment_id`
  > Source comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments) when the mention
  > appears in a comment.
- `mentioned_user_id`: Mentioned user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `mentioned_handle`
  > The literal handle string used in the content (business validation on
  > handle format enforced in application).
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the mention was recorded.
- `updated_at`: Technical update timestamp for the mention record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retracted/invalid mentions.

### `civicdebateboard_claim_excerpts`

Anchored factual claim excerpts selected from user-generated content for
evidence-first fact checking. Each record identifies an immutable
selection from either a [civicdebateboard_posts](#civicdebateboard_posts) post or a {@link
civicdebateboard_comments} comment using character offsets, and preserves
the selected text for audit. Exactly one of post or comment should be set
by business rule (enforced at application level).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`
  > Source post for the claim selection. Target model's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_posts.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_comment_id`
  > Source comment for the claim selection. Target model's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_comments.id}.
- `selection_method`
  > Selection capture method. Typical values: "char_range" (character
  > offsets) or "text_match" (best-effort quote match).
- `start_offset`
  > Zero-based character index where the selection starts within the source
  > content snapshot.
- `end_offset`
  > Zero-based character index where the selection ends (exclusive) within
  > the source content snapshot. Must be >= start_offset.
- `excerpt_text`
  > Exact text of the selected claim excerpt preserved for audit and review
  > context.
- `context_before`
  > Optional nearby text that precedes the excerpt to aid reviewer context
  > (may be truncated).
- `context_after`
  > Optional nearby text that follows the excerpt to aid reviewer context
  > (may be truncated).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (UTC).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_annotations`

Fact-check annotations authored by a factChecker on a specific {@link
civicdebateboard_claim_excerpts}. Stores rating and explanatory note.
Proposals that may affect enforcement are marked but actual outcomes are
handled via [civicdebateboard_annotation_reviews](#civicdebateboard_annotation_reviews) and lifecycle
history in [civicdebateboard_annotation_status_changes](#civicdebateboard_annotation_status_changes).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_claim_excerpt_id`: Annotated claim excerpt. [civicdebateboard_claim_excerpts.id](#civicdebateboard_claim_excerpts)
- `civicdebateboard_factchecker_id`: Authoring factChecker account. [civicdebateboard_factcheckers.id](#civicdebateboard_factcheckers)
- `rating`
  > Classification of the claim: e.g., "accurate", "needs_context",
  > "misleading", "false", "unsupported".
- `explanation`
  > Human-readable explanation summarizing reasoning and key evidence for the
  > rating.
- `enforcement_affecting`
  > Whether this annotation proposes an enforcement-affecting label
  > (distribution limits, interstitials, removal). Requires moderator review
  > before effect.
- `proposed_label`
  > Optional proposed policy label (e.g., "reduce_distribution", "age_gate",
  > "remove_content").
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (UTC).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_annotation_sources`

Citation sources attached to an [civicdebateboard_annotations](#civicdebateboard_annotations)
record. Each entry references a specific URL (and optional metadata) used
to support the fact-check reasoning. Designed to avoid duplicates per
annotation and enable evidence audits.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_annotation_id`: Parent annotation. [civicdebateboard_annotations.id](#civicdebateboard_annotations)
- `source_url`: Primary citation URL (http/https).
- `title`: Optional display title of the source material.
- `publisher`: Optional publisher or organization associated with the source.
- `accessed_at`
  > Optional date/time when the source was last accessed or verified by the
  > reviewer.
- `archived_url`: Optional archive URL or snapshot reference used to preserve evidence.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (UTC).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_annotation_reviews`

Moderator reviews for [civicdebateboard_annotations](#civicdebateboard_annotations). Records
reviewer identity, decision outcome, and optional linkage to the policy
version applied at the time. Enforces at most one review per moderator
per annotation to support independence and audit practices. Subsequent
changes are tracked as new records, maintaining history.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_annotation_id`: Reviewed annotation. [civicdebateboard_annotations.id](#civicdebateboard_annotations)
- `civicdebateboard_moderator_id`: Reviewing moderator. [civicdebateboard_moderators.id](#civicdebateboard_moderators)
- `civicdebateboard_policy_version_id`
  > Optional policy version context used during review. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id}
- `decision`
  > Review decision such as "accepted", "rejected", "needs_changes", or
  > "contested".
- `notes`
  > Optional reviewer notes that summarize rationale and references for the
  > decision.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (UTC).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_annotation_status_changes`

Lifecycle history for [civicdebateboard_annotations](#civicdebateboard_annotations). Captures
transitions like proposed → accepted/contested/rejected with the acting
user for full accountability and audit trails. Maintains a temporal
record without storing computed current status on the base entity.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_annotation_id`
  > Target annotation for the status transition. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_annotations.id}
- `actor_user_id`
  > User who performed the transition (could be factChecker, moderator, or
  > admin). [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users)
- `from_status`
  > Previous lifecycle status before the transition. Null for the initial
  > snapshot.
- `to_status`
  > New lifecycle status after the transition. Examples: "proposed",
  > "accepted", "contested", "rejected".
- `reason`: Optional human-readable reason or note for the transition.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (UTC).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (UTC).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_notification_preferences`

Per-user notification preferences controlling delivery channels,
bundling, digest scheduling, and quiet hours. This is a 1:1 extension of
[civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) and drives how notifications are sent or
suppressed. Used by notification pipelines to respect user
locale/timezone behavior and quiet hours.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`
  > Owner user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users). Exactly one preferences
  > row per user.
- `default_delivery_mode`
  > Default delivery mode for notifications: values like "instant" or
  > "digest" chosen by the user.
- `enable_in_app`: Whether in-app notifications are enabled for the user.
- `enable_email`: Whether email notifications are enabled for the user.
- `enable_push`: Whether push notifications are enabled for the user.
- `bundle_window_minutes`
  > Window in minutes to bundle multiple notifications into a single group to
  > reduce noise.
- `digest_enabled`: Whether a periodic digest is enabled for the user.
- `digest_hour_local`
  > Local-hour (0–23) at which the digest should be delivered for the user.
  > Null when digest is disabled.
- `quiet_hours_start_minute`
  > Quiet hours start minute of day (0–1439) in the user’s locale. Null when
  > not configured.
- `quiet_hours_end_minute`
  > Quiet hours end minute of day (0–1439) in the user’s locale. Null when
  > not configured.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_notifications`

User-facing notification records representing events like replies,
mentions, moderation decisions, appeals, annotations, or other system
updates. Each notification belongs to a recipient {@link
civicdebateboard_users} and may reference related domain objects for
context. Optionally linked to a [civicdebateboard_digests](#civicdebateboard_digests) when
delivered in a batch.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Recipient user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`
  > Related post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts) when the notification
  > concerns a post.
- `civicdebateboard_comment_id`
  > Related comment's [civicdebateboard_comments.id](#civicdebateboard_comments) when the
  > notification concerns a comment or reply.
- `civicdebateboard_thread_id`
  > Related thread's [civicdebateboard_threads.id](#civicdebateboard_threads) when the
  > notification is thread-scoped.
- `civicdebateboard_moderation_action_id`
  > Related moderation action's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_moderation_actions.id} for enforcement outcomes.
- `civicdebateboard_appeal_decision_id`
  > Related appeal decision's [civicdebateboard_appeal_decisions.id](#civicdebateboard_appeal_decisions)
  > when appeals resolve.
- `civicdebateboard_annotation_id`
  > Related annotation's [civicdebateboard_annotations.id](#civicdebateboard_annotations) for
  > fact-check visibility or status changes.
- `civicdebateboard_report_id`
  > Related report's [civicdebateboard_reports.id](#civicdebateboard_reports) for report
  > acknowledgements or outcomes.
- `civicdebateboard_digest_id`
  > Linked digest's [civicdebateboard_digests.id](#civicdebateboard_digests) when the notification
  > is delivered within a digest.
- `category`
  > Business category for the notification (e.g., reply, mention,
  > moderation_decision, appeal_result, annotation_published).
- `title`: Short subject or title shown to the user when applicable.
- `body`: Human-readable body text for the notification when applicable.
- `delivery_mode`: Delivery mode used: "instant" or "digest" at the time of send.
- `channel`: Channel used to deliver the notification (e.g., in_app, email, push).
- `sent_at`: Time the notification was sent via its channel. Null for pending items.
- `read_at`: Time the notification was read by the recipient. Null if unread.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

and may reference the user and device used.

- `error_code`: Machine-readable error code returned by downstream provider or system.
- `error_message`: Human-readable error details. May be truncated as appropriate.
- `attempt`: Monotonic attempt number for this notification delivery.

- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

- `timezone_at_scheduling`
  > Timezone identifier captured at scheduling time for audit and
  > reconstruction (e.g., Asia/Seoul).

- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_subscriptions`

Subscriber-level configuration for content updates independent of
specific targets. A subscription belongs to a {@link
civicdebateboard_users} account and defines preferences such as delivery
mode and whether it participates in digests. Specific targets (authors,
threads, posts, topics, categories) are attached via {@link
civicdebateboard_subscription_targets}. Enforces at most one subscription
per user per delivery mode to prevent duplication across targets.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Subscriber user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `delivery_mode`: Preferred delivery mode for this subscription (e.g., instant or digest).
- `muted`: Whether notifications from targets under this subscription are muted.
- `digest_enabled`: Whether this subscription contributes items to periodic digests.
- `active`: Whether the subscription is currently active.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_subscription_targets`

Junction table linking a [civicdebateboard_subscriptions](#civicdebateboard_subscriptions) record to
one specific target entity. Supports multiple target kinds via nullable
foreign keys with strong referential integrity (author user, thread,
post, topic, category). The target_type classifier aids routing and
analytics while remaining non-authoritative compared to FKs.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_subscription_id`: Owning subscription's [civicdebateboard_subscriptions.id](#civicdebateboard_subscriptions).

  > Target author user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) when following an

- `civicdebateboard_thread_id`
  > Target thread's [civicdebateboard_threads.id](#civicdebateboard_threads) when following a
  > thread.
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Target post's [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts) when following a post.
- `civicdebateboard_topic_id`: Target topic's [civicdebateboard_topics.id](#civicdebateboard_topics) when following a topic.
- `civicdebateboard_category_id`
  > Target category's [civicdebateboard_categories.id](#civicdebateboard_categories) when following a
  > category.
- `target_type`
  > Classifier for the target kind (author, thread, post, topic, category) to
  > simplify routing and analytics.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_audit_logs`

Immutable audit trail of security- and policy-relevant events across the
platform. Records actor identity, optional target, action semantics,
outcome, correlation id, and minimal context for investigations. Foreign
keys are nullable and use ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve evidence if
parent records are removed. Links to [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) and
[civicdebateboard_sessions](#civicdebateboard_sessions).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_user_id`
  > Acting user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users). Optional for
  > system-generated events.
- `target_user_id`
  > Target user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) when the action concerns
  > another account.
- `civicdebateboard_session_id`
  > Related session's [civicdebateboard_sessions.id](#civicdebateboard_sessions) if the action
  > occurred within a session context.
- `action`
  > Semantic action name (e.g., login, logout_all, role_change,
  > sanction_issue).
- `target_type`
  > High-level category of the target object (e.g., user, post, comment,
  > policy, export).
- `target_id`
  > Identifier of the target object when applicable. Not a foreign key to
  > preserve polymorphism.
- `reason_code`
  > Categorical reason or policy code associated with the action, when
  > applicable.
- `outcome`: Outcome classification (success, denied, error).
- `ip`
  > Best-effort source IP string captured at time of action
  > (privacy-minimized).
- `user_agent`: User-Agent string or simplified client identifier for context.
- `correlation_id`
  > Correlation identifier to link multi-step processes and cross-service
  > events.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retention and purge workflows.

### `civicdebateboard_privacy_events`

Privacy ledger of consent and privacy-related events (e.g.,
consent_granted, consent_withdrawn, gpc_opt_out). Optionally linked to
[civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) and [civicdebateboard_sessions](#civicdebateboard_sessions) for
traceability. Foreign keys are nullable and set to null on parent
deletion to preserve ledger entries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`
  > Related user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) when the event is
  > attributable to an account.
- `civicdebateboard_session_id`
  > Related session's [civicdebateboard_sessions.id](#civicdebateboard_sessions) if captured during
  > an authenticated session.
- `event_type`
  > Type of privacy event (e.g., consent_granted, consent_withdrawn,
  > gpc_opt_out).
- `purpose`: Processing purpose key (e.g., analytics, marketing, personalized_ads).
- `legal_basis`
  > Stated legal basis for processing when applicable (e.g., consent,
  > contract, legitimate_interest).
- `source`: Origin of the event (web, api, mobile, gpc).
- `notes`: Optional human-readable notes regarding the event for audit review.
- `correlation_id`: Correlation identifier for cross-flow traceability.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retention lifecycle.

### `civicdebateboard_dsar_requests`

Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) records covering access, deletion,
correction, portability, and restriction requests. Captures reference
code, workflow status, due date, and closure time. Adds explicit fields
for lawful deadline extensions with notification and reasons. Reviewer
admin is nullable and set to null on delete; subject user relationship is
RESTRICT to protect records.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`: Requesting data subject's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `reviewer_admin_id`: Assigned reviewer admin's [civicdebateboard_admins.id](#civicdebateboard_admins) if any.
- `request_type`: Type of DSAR (access, deletion, correction, portability, restriction).
- `status`: Workflow status (pending, in_progress, completed, denied).
- `reference_code`
  > Business reference code to track the DSAR across communications and
  > reports.
- `due_at`
  > Regulatory due date for fulfilling the request, adjusted for applicable
  > jurisdiction.
- `closed_at`: Timestamp when the request was completed or closed.
- `extension_applied`: Whether a lawful extension was applied for this DSAR.
- `extension_notified_at`: Timestamp when the requester was notified of the extension, if applied.
- `extension_reason`
  > Justification for the extension communicated to the requester, if
  > applicable.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp to align with retention policy.

### `civicdebateboard_incidents`

Security and privacy incident register with severity, status, timestamps,
and summary narrative. Optionally linked to a reporting {@link
civicdebateboard_admins} account; the relation is nullable and set to
null on delete to preserve the incident record.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `reported_by_admin_id`
  > Reporting admin's [civicdebateboard_admins.id](#civicdebateboard_admins) if the incident was
  > filed by staff.
- `reference_code`: Unique human-reference code for the incident.
- `severity`: Severity classification (e.g., sev1, sev2, sev3) aligned with policy.
- `status`: Lifecycle status (detected, triage, contained, resolved, closed).
- `personal_data_involved`: Whether personal data is reasonably believed to be involved.
- `started_at`: When the security/privacy incident began or was first observed.
- `contained_at`: When the incident was contained, if applicable.
- `resolved_at`: When recovery was completed and the incident resolved, if applicable.
- `summary`
  > Narrative summary suitable for internal review and, if necessary,
  > external notification preparation.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retention governance.

### `civicdebateboard_incident_notifications`

Per-incident notification ledger tracking communications to authorities
and affected users. Links to [civicdebateboard_incidents](#civicdebateboard_incidents) and
optionally [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users). Enforces uniqueness of
(incident, recipient_user, channel) for user-targeted notifications;
non-user recipients may require application-level duplication controls.
Recipient user FK is nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve the
ledger.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_incident_id`: Incident reference [civicdebateboard_incidents.id](#civicdebateboard_incidents).
- `recipient_user_id`
  > Recipient user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users) when notifying an
  > identifiable user.
- `recipient_channel`
  > Notification channel or audience (e.g., authority, affected_users, email,
  > public_post).
- `delivery_status`: Delivery outcome (queued, sent, failed).
- `notified_at`: Timestamp when the notification was sent or published.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `civicdebateboard_third_party_processors`

Registry of third-party processors (subprocessors) handling personal
data. Captures legal and operational attributes including DPA execution,
data locality, and service category. Used for compliance transparency and
risk reviews.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Legal or trading name of the third-party processor.
- `service_category`
  > Primary service category (e.g., email_delivery, analytics,
  > identity_verification).
- `data_categories`: Summary of personal data categories processed (normalized list).
- `contact_uri`: Public contact or privacy page URI for the processor.
- `dpa_executed`: Whether a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is executed and current.
- `data_locality`: Primary data locality/region for processing (e.g., EU, US, multi-region).
- `active`: Whether the processor is currently active in production flows.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp aligned to retention rules.

### `civicdebateboard_data_exports`

Governance record for data exports involving personal data. Logs
requester ([civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users)), optional approver ({@link
civicdebateboard_admins}), business scope, reason, status, and optional
signed download URI with expirations. Approver FK uses SET NULL on
delete; requester FK uses RESTRICT to protect governance trail.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `requested_by_user_id`: Requesting user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `approved_by_admin_id`: Approving admin's [civicdebateboard_admins.id](#civicdebateboard_admins), if applicable.
- `reference_code`: Unique external reference for the export request.
- `status`
  > Workflow status (requested, approved, rejected, processing, completed,
  > expired).
- `scope`: Business scope description (e.g., account_export, moderation_case_export).
- `reason`: Optional business justification for the export.
- `completed_at`: Completion timestamp when the export is ready.
- `expires_at`: Expiration timestamp for the download link or access window.
- `download_uri`: Signed or restricted download URI for the export package, when generated.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp per retention policy.

### `civicdebateboard_policy_acknowledgments`

Evidence of user acknowledgments of policy/versioned documents. Ensures a
user can acknowledge a specific [civicdebateboard_policy_versions](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions)
exactly once. Supports audit and compliance reviews.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_policy_version_id`: Acknowledged policy version's [civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions).
- `user_id`: Acknowledging user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `acknowledged_at`: Timestamp when the user acknowledged the policy version.
- `locale`
  > Locale (e.g., en-US) shown at the time of acknowledgment, for audit
  > context.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, retained for governance reviews.

### `civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns`

Advertising campaign definitions with lifecycle, policy guardrails,
political flag, blackout/election window linkage, budgets, per-user caps,
and disclosure text. Provides the configuration basis for placements and
delivery enforcement. Key relationships: [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users),
[civicdebateboard_policy_versions](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions), {@link
civicdebateboard_election_windows}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Creator account's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_policy_version_id`
  > Policy baseline applied to this campaign. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_election_window_id`
  > Election blackout window reference when applicable. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_election_windows.id}.
- `code`
  > Business identifier for the campaign used in operations and billing
  > reconciliation. Must be unique.
- `name`: Human-readable campaign name for operators and reporting.
- `objective`: High-level objective (e.g., awareness, engagement).
- `status`: Lifecycle state: planned, active, paused, ended, or canceled.
- `starts_at`: Campaign scheduled start timestamp.
- `ends_at`: Campaign scheduled end timestamp.
- `budget_usd`
  > Maximum spend budget for the campaign in USD (raw configuration, not
  > computed).
- `daily_impression_cap`: Cap on total impressions per day across all placements for this campaign.
- `per_user_daily_cap`: Cap on impressions per unique user per day, for frequency management.
- `disclosure_text`: Required disclosure label to accompany ads for transparency.
- `is_political`
  > Whether the content is political in nature for blackout and guardrail
  > enforcement.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_ad_placements`

Ad placement bindings between campaigns and specific presentation
surfaces (category, topic, or post). Stores slot name and optional
per-user daily frequency cap at the placement level. Ensures strict 3NF
by keeping a single frequency cap field (no alias duplication). Key
relationships: [civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns](#civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns), {@link
civicdebateboard_categories}, [civicdebateboard_topics](#civicdebateboard_topics), {@link
civicdebateboard_posts}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_ad_campaign_id`: Owning campaign's [civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns.id](#civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns).
- `civicdebateboard_category_id`: Target category surface. [civicdebateboard_categories.id](#civicdebateboard_categories).
- `civicdebateboard_topic_id`: Target topic surface. [civicdebateboard_topics.id](#civicdebateboard_topics).
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Target specific post surface. [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `placement_slot`
  > Logical slot name (e.g., topic_sidebar, thread_inline) for rendering
  > decisions.
- `frequency_cap_per_user_per_day`
  > Maximum impressions per unique user per day for this placement (nullable
  > to inherit/disable at placement level).
- `starts_at`: Placement active start timestamp.
- `ends_at`: Placement active end timestamp.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the record is logically removed.

### `civicdebateboard_ad_impressions`

Immutable ad impression logs tied to a specific placement, with optional
association to the viewing user and session. Designed for high-volume
writes and time-window queries supporting frequency capping and
analytics. Stores raw billed cost when available and click outcome. Key
relationships: [civicdebateboard_ad_placements](#civicdebateboard_ad_placements), {@link
civicdebateboard_users}, [civicdebateboard_sessions](#civicdebateboard_sessions).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_ad_placement_id`: Served placement's [civicdebateboard_ad_placements.id](#civicdebateboard_ad_placements).
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`
  > Viewer's account when known for frequency capping. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_users.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_session_id`
  > Device session reference when available. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_sessions.id}.
- `appeared_at`: Timestamp when the impression was rendered to the user.
- `clicked`: Whether the impression resulted in a click event.
- `clicked_at`: Timestamp of the click, present only if clicked is true.
- `cost_usd`
  > Raw billed cost attributed to this impression in USD when available from
  > billing pipeline.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp for the impression log.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the impression log.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the log is removed under policy.

### `civicdebateboard_sponsorships`

Sponsorship agreements that fund topic hubs, series, or events with
strict guardrails. Stores sponsor identity, disclosure text, status, and
active window. Optionally references a policy version in effect at time
of agreement. Sponsored surfaces ({@link
civicdebateboard_sponsored_surfaces}) associate sponsorships to concrete
categories/topics/posts.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Creator or owner operator's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_policy_version_id`
  > Policy version applicable to the sponsorship. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id}.
- `code`
  > Business identifier for the sponsorship; unique for disclosures and
  > reconciliation.
- `sponsor_name`: Public name of the sponsoring organization.
- `disclosure_text`: Disclosure label text shown on sponsored surfaces.
- `sponsor_contact_uri`
  > Contact or information URI for the sponsor, used in disclosures or admin
  > coordination.
- `status`: Lifecycle state: pending, active, paused, ended, or canceled.
- `starts_at`: Agreement start timestamp for sponsorship visibility.
- `ends_at`
  > Agreement end timestamp; sponsorship visibility should end after this
  > time.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_sponsored_surfaces`

Associations of a sponsorship to specific surfaces: a category, topic, or
individual post. Uniqueness across the surface fields prevents duplicate
sponsorship assignments. Each record controls an optional label override
and active window for display governance on that surface.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_sponsorship_id`: Linked sponsorship's [civicdebateboard_sponsorships.id](#civicdebateboard_sponsorships).
- `civicdebateboard_category_id`: Target category surface. [civicdebateboard_categories.id](#civicdebateboard_categories).
- `civicdebateboard_topic_id`: Target topic surface. [civicdebateboard_topics.id](#civicdebateboard_topics).
- `civicdebateboard_post_id`: Target specific post surface. [civicdebateboard_posts.id](#civicdebateboard_posts).
- `label_override`: Optional override for disclosure label on this specific surface.
- `starts_at`: Start timestamp for sponsorship visibility on this surface.
- `ends_at`: End timestamp for sponsorship visibility on this surface.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_paid_subscription_plans`

Catalog of paid subscription plans offered to users. Stores raw
attributes including price and billing interval. Plans are created by
operators and can be activated/deactivated without affecting historical
subscriptions or invoices. No calculated aggregates are stored here; all
fields are raw configuration values.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`
  > Operator who created or last managed the plan. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_users.id}.
- `code`: Unique code for the plan used in checkout and invoicing.
- `name`: Human-readable plan name.
- `description`: Plan description for display and operator context.
- `price_usd`: Recurring price in USD for the billing interval.
- `billing_interval`: Billing interval (e.g., monthly, yearly).
- `trial_days`: Number of trial days offered for this plan, if any.
- `is_active`: Whether the plan is available for new purchases.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_paid_subscriptions`

User subscriptions to paid plans with lifecycle timestamps and flags.
Enforces at most one active subscription per (user, plan) via composite
uniqueness on the active flag. Stores only raw state and dates; no
computed revenue or aggregates. Invoices ({@link
civicdebateboard_subscription_invoices}) reference these records for
billing events.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_paid_subscription_plan_id`: Subscribed plan's [civicdebateboard_paid_subscription_plans.id](#civicdebateboard_paid_subscription_plans).
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Subscribing user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `status`: Lifecycle state: trialing, active, past_due, canceled, or expired.
- `active`: Whether this row represents the active subscription for (user, plan).
- `auto_renew`: Whether the subscription will auto-renew at the next cycle.
- `started_at`: Subscription start timestamp.
- `trial_end_at`: Timestamp when trial ends if trialing.
- `ends_at`: Subscription end timestamp when canceled or expired.
- `canceled_at`: Timestamp when the user or system canceled auto-renew.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_subscription_invoices`

Invoices generated for paid subscriptions. Tracks issued/due/paid
timestamps and raw amounts for a specific billing period. Each invoice
belongs to exactly one paid subscription; invoice_code is unique for
reconciliation. No totals or taxes are computed here beyond stored raw
amounts attributed to the invoice record.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_paid_subscription_id`: Related subscription's [civicdebateboard_paid_subscriptions.id](#civicdebateboard_paid_subscriptions).
- `invoice_code`: Unique invoice identifier used in billing systems and receipts.
- `amount_usd`: Billed amount in USD for this invoice (raw number as recorded).
- `period_start`: Start timestamp of the service period covered by this invoice.
- `period_end`: End timestamp of the service period covered by this invoice.
- `issued_at`: Timestamp when the invoice was issued.
- `due_at`: Timestamp when payment is due.
- `paid_at`: Timestamp when payment was recorded as completed.
- `status`: Invoice status: issued, paid, failed, or void.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_grants`

Grants and public-interest funding records with amounts, timelines, and
disclosure/oversight needs. Each grant may be owned by an operator user
and includes reporting due dates. Stores only raw fields and statuses;
financial aggregations are handled outside of this table.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Operator owning the grant record. [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `code`: Unique business identifier for the grant used in reporting and oversight.
- `grant_name`: Grant title or program name.
- `funder_name`: Organization providing the grant funding.
- `amount_awarded_usd`: Awarded amount in USD (raw value as approved).
- `awarded_at`: Date/time when the grant was awarded.
- `reporting_due_at`: Next reporting due date for compliance with grant conditions.
- `restricted_purpose`
  > Any restrictions on use (e.g., fact-checking program) described in
  > business terms.
- `contact_uri`: Contact or public disclosure link related to the grant.
- `status`: Lifecycle state: proposed, awarded, active, or closed.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed.

### `civicdebateboard_monetization_experiments`

Monetization-focused experiments with governance guardrails and
ownership. Experiments may link to an ad campaign or sponsorship and are
owned by a user. Stores hypothesis, time window, status, and guardrail
KPI references; no metrics or computed results are kept here (results
live in analytics components).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`
  > Experiment owner responsible for governance and review. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_users.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_ad_campaign_id`
  > Optional linkage to a related ad campaign under test. {@link
  > civicdebateboard_ad_campaigns.id}.
- `civicdebateboard_sponsorship_id`

### `civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries`

Authoritative registry of analytics metrics and KPIs for the platform.
Defines purpose, lawful basis, consent needs, retention policy, and
documentation links. Referenced by {@link
civicdebateboard_kpi_measurements}, [civicdebateboard_experiments](#civicdebateboard_experiments)
(as primary/secondary metrics), and {@link
civicdebateboard_experiment_results}. Enables privacy-by-design by
explicitly documenting business context.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Creator user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `policy_version_id`: Governing policy version's [civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions).
- `code`
  > Unique business code for the metric (e.g., kpi_mau,
  > kpi_fact_check_coverage).
- `name`: Human-readable metric name for stakeholders.
- `description`
  > Detailed business description and calculation notes (business-level, not
  > computed here).
- `purpose`: Purpose of processing/measurement (e.g., growth, safety, monetization).
- `lawful_basis`
  > Lawful basis for processing (e.g., contract, legitimate_interest,
  > consent).
- `consent_required`: Whether user consent is required for this metric processing.
- `consent_purpose_key`: Consent registry key or scope name if consent is required.
- `contains_personal_data`: Whether the metric involves personal data at any stage of processing.
- `retention_period_days`
  > Default retention period in days for raw measurement records associated
  > with this metric.
- `owner_team`: Accountable team or function responsible for the metric.
- `documentation_uri`: Reference documentation link for metric definition and governance notes.
- `active`: Whether this metric is currently active and eligible for reporting.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_kpi_measurements`

Time-bucketed KPI/metric observations tied to a registry entry. Stores
raw measured values per metric/period/segment to support analytics and
governance reporting. References {@link
civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries}. Adds an index to accelerate
end-bounded window queries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `metric_registry_entry_id`
  > Target registry metric's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries.id}.
- `created_by_user_id`: Creator user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `period_start`: Start of the measurement period (inclusive).
- `period_end`: End of the measurement period (exclusive).
- `period_granularity`: Granularity of the period (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly).
- `value`
  > Measured numeric value for the KPI/metric in the specified period and
  > segment.
- `sample_size`: Count of samples included in the measurement window.
- `segment_key`: Normalized key expressing the segment (e.g., role=member;region=kr).
- `segment_description`: Human-readable description of the segment definition.
- `notes`: Optional analyst or governance notes about this measurement.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_experiments`

Experiment registry for A/B or multi-variant tests. Captures hypothesis,
governance status, schedule, and links to primary/secondary registry
metrics used for evaluation. Referenced by {@link
civicdebateboard_experiment_exposures} and {@link
civicdebateboard_experiment_results}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `primary_metric_registry_entry_id`
  > Primary evaluation metric's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries.id}.
- `secondary_metric_registry_entry_id`
  > Secondary evaluation metric's {@link
  > civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries.id}.
- `created_by_user_id`: Experiment creator user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_feature_toggle_id`
  > Related feature toggle's [civicdebateboard_feature_toggles.id](#civicdebateboard_feature_toggles) if
  > applicable.
- `code`: Unique experiment code (e.g., exp_ama_badge_visibility).
- `name`: Human-readable experiment name.
- `hypothesis`: Business hypothesis being tested.
- `status`: Lifecycle status (e.g., draft, running, paused, completed).
- `exposure_unit`: Assignment unit (e.g., user, session).
- `start_at`: Planned/actual start time.
- `end_at`: Planned/actual end time.
- `max_concurrent_exposures`: Optional cap on concurrent exposures for safety/governance.
- `notes`: Operational or governance notes.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_experiment_exposures`

Assignment records mapping experiment subjects to variants and cohorts.
Represents the M:N relation between [civicdebateboard_experiments](#civicdebateboard_experiments)
and [civicdebateboard_users](#civicdebateboard_users) with temporal context. Optionally
linked to [civicdebateboard_sessions](#civicdebateboard_sessions) for device-level attribution.
Adds integrity guard for session-scoped experiments and an index to
accelerate variant tallies.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_experiment_id`: Experiment's [civicdebateboard_experiments.id](#civicdebateboard_experiments).
- `civicdebateboard_user_id`: Exposed user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `civicdebateboard_session_id`: Optional session context's [civicdebateboard_sessions.id](#civicdebateboard_sessions).
- `variant_key`: Assigned variant key (e.g., control, treatment_a).
- `cohort_key`: Optional cohort key for segmentation (e.g., region=kr).
- `assigned_at`: Timestamp when the exposure assignment occurred.
- `exposure_context`: Optional textual context for assignment (e.g., rule id, allocator).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_experiment_results`

Recorded analysis outcomes per experiment, metric, variant, and analysis
window. Provides auditable storage of statistical outputs without
denormalizing upstream data. References {@link
civicdebateboard_experiments} and {@link
civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries}. Adds a composite index to
speed variant-sliced window retrieval.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `civicdebateboard_experiment_id`: Experiment's [civicdebateboard_experiments.id](#civicdebateboard_experiments).
- `metric_registry_entry_id`: Evaluated metric's [civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries.id](#civicdebateboard_metric_registry_entries).
- `variant_key`: Variant key for which the result applies (e.g., control, treatment_a).
- `analysis_window_start`: Start of analysis window (inclusive).
- `analysis_window_end`: End of analysis window (exclusive).
- `value`: Measured effect or metric value computed for the window and variant.
- `standard_error`: Estimated standard error for the measurement.
- `p_value`: P-value for hypothesis testing associated with the result.
- `significant`: Whether the result meets pre-defined significance criteria.
- `method`: Analytical method identifier (e.g., t_test, CUPED).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.

### `civicdebateboard_business_review_logs`

Governance business review logs (weekly/monthly/quarterly). Records
period, status, summary, and accountable owners. Supports transparency
and audit for metrics reviews and decisions. References {@link
civicdebateboard_users} and [civicdebateboard_policy_versions](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_user_id`: Creator user's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `owner_user_id`: Accountable owner's [civicdebateboard_users.id](#civicdebateboard_users).
- `policy_version_id`
  > Referenced policy version's [civicdebateboard_policy_versions.id](#civicdebateboard_policy_versions)
  > for this review period.
- `review_type`: Type of review (e.g., weekly_ops, monthly_business, quarterly_strategy).
- `period_start`: Start of the review period (inclusive).
- `period_end`: End of the review period (exclusive).
- `status`: Lifecycle status (e.g., drafted, published, amended).
- `summary`: Human-readable summary of key outcomes and decisions.
- `action_items`: Optional action items and owners recorded as plain text.
- `document_uri`: Optional URI to the detailed review document or dashboard.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if applicable.
